cc:Work.dc:title: Misc - CoinDisplay
cc:Work.dc:description:
A showcase for a single coin
Created with Boxes.py (https://boxes.hackerspace-bamberg.de/) Command line: boxes CoinDisplay --x 90 --y 90 --h 90 --thickness 3 --labels 1 --reference 0 Command line short: boxes CoinDisplay --x --y --h --reference
